resources.string: Hattie listens for her name and answers out loud.
Which house is this tablet for?
Type the address of the box that runs Hattie. Nothing else about this tablet is sent anywhere: it talks to that box and to nothing else.
For example 192.168.1.8, or hattie.local if the box answers to that name on your network.
I need the address of the box first.
This tablet will not need signing in again.
